title: El Dorado Offerings in Lake Guatavita: A Muisca Ritual Archaeological Site
creator: Juan Pablo Quintero-Guzmán
provenance: Latin American Antiquity 35(2), pp. 483–499; Cambridge University Press; author affiliated with Banco de la República, Museo del Oro.
notes: Reports results of a 2009 archaeological survey around Lake Guatavita.
Material distribution supports a shrine with small-scale offerings rather than conspicuous mass celebrations.
